commands.data: One Apprentice can work here at a time. Each villager unlocks their own workplace types.
Apprentices load furnaces, replenish your chosen fuel and collect finished materials.
No workplace type matches. Clear the search or choose All.
Smelts ore into bars. Needs a Furnace.
Apprentices load furnaces, replenish your chosen fuel and collect finished materials.
Forges weapons and tools. Needs a Blacksmith's Anvil.
Apprentices forge weapons and tools at a blacksmith's anvil.
Tends crops for food support. Needs a Farmer's Workbench.
Tending crops provides ten food points. This site produces no items.
Digs tunnels for ore and stone. Needs a Workbench.
Mark a base around a Workbench. Use the bench to plan connected tunnels and stairs on a map, switch floors and manage digging. Workers carry the drops to core mine storage.
Builds your town's projects. Needs a Builder's Workbench.
Queue started town construction at a Builder's Workbench. Apprentices travel to the project and build reachable pieces. Better Building skill and equipment improve their pace.
Makes supplies and tools. Needs a Workbench.
Apprentices make supplies and useful tools at a workbench.
Makes armor and guard kits. Needs an Armorer's Workbench.

Tends animals for food support. Needs a Feeding Trough.
Locked. Costs 100 gold at the Rancher.

Locked. The Druid must move in first.

Place Mushroom Logs and choose one kind of mushroom to grow. An Apprentice seeds each log, tends it as it grows and picks the mushrooms into the workplace store. Rarer mushrooms need more Farming skill.
Picks berries from bushes. Needs a Farmer's Workbench.

Cuts building blocks to order. Needs a Builder's Workbench.

Brews potions. Needs an Alchemist's Workbench.

Apprentices brew potions from gathered and cultivated ingredients.
Breaks old gear into materials. Needs a Salvager's Workbench.
Locked. Costs 100 gold at the Crafter.
Apprentices take apart old weapons, armor and tools at a salvager's workbench and send the recovered materials to Crafted Goods.
Tans hides into leather goods. Needs a Tanning Rack.
Locked. The Leatherworker must move in first.
Apprentices tan hides into leather and prepare leather goods.
Cooks food to order. Needs a Chef's Stove.
Locked. The Chef must move in first.
Apprentices cook food items for you. This site does not increase town food support.
Crafts rings and necklaces. Needs a Jewelry Crafting Bench.

Apprentices craft jewelry. An appraisal bench lets new jewelry arrive appraised.
